plain.li: [notice:growth] Every plant out there is leaning toward the same tree.
[notice:growth] The leaves are drifting all one way, and there isn't a breath of wind.
[notice:growth] Look at the field, I swear it's grown since this morning.
[notice:growth,named] {GOD} is listening, so mind what you cut today.
[notice:growth,named] {GOD} is near, everything green is turned to her.
[notice:growth,scoffer] Plants lean to the light, that's all this is.
[axe] That felt wrong, like I was cutting into something awake.
[axe] The whole tree shuddered before it went, I didn't like it.
[axe,named] {GOD} won't forget that one, I could feel it.
[notice:warmstone] The rock's warm to the touch, like something's breathing in it.
[notice:warmstone] There's steam coming out of the cracks at the foot of the rock.
[notice:warmstone] Ash is falling, fine as flour, and the stone is warm.
[notice:warmstone,named] {GOD} is breathing under us, can you feel the floor?
[notice:warmstone,scoffer] Warm rock and a bit of steam, the ground does that.
[notice:grazing] The deer are lying down right next to it, they're not afraid at all.
[notice:grazing] Nothing out there is running from anything today.
[notice:grazing] I was going to shout at someone, and I just couldn't be bothered.
[notice:grazing,named] Let {GOD} pass, and be quiet while he does.
[notice:grazing,scoffer] A big tame beast and a lot of calm animals, nothing more.
[notice:rot] There are spores on the air, pale little things, everywhere.
[notice:rot] Mushrooms came up in a ring overnight, and the meat's already turning.
[notice:rot] Everything smells of wet earth today, even indoors.
[notice:rot,named] {GOD} is close, get the food into the cold.
[notice:rot,scoffer] Damp weather, mushrooms, rot, it happens every year.
[notice:warmth] The fire's been burning all evening and hardly needed a log.
[notice:warmth] It feels like a festival night, and nobody planned one.
[notice:warmth] Even the dogs are following our guest about.
[notice:warmth,named] {GOD} is under our roof, so make the welcome good.
[notice:warmth,scoffer] A warm night and a good fire, I won't argue with that.
[notice:hum] The lights are pulsing, slow and steady, like something breathing.
[notice:hum] Can you hear the wires humming to themselves?
[notice:hum] The batteries haven't dropped all day, how is that?
[notice:hum,named] {GOD} is awake in the wires, I'd say hello.
[notice:hum,scoffer] A loose connection makes lights do that, someone check it.
[prank] This door won't open for me, it opens for everyone else.
[prank] I can't get this door to budge, and it's not even locked.
[prank] The door's stuck, but only when I try it, I swear.
[prank,named] Very funny, {GOD}, now let me through.
[prankend] There, now it opens, of course it does.
[prankend] Somebody else opens it and it's fine, unbelievable.
[notice:highsky] The sky's never looked that high before.
[notice:highsky] Lightning over the hills, and not a drop of rain here.
[notice:highsky] Every bird is gone, and the sky is perfectly clear.
[notice:highsky,named] {GOD} is looking down today, I can feel it.
[notice:highsky,scoffer] Clear weather and dry lightning far off, that's all.
[notice:whitesilence] Nobody said a word for hours, and nobody could say why.
[notice:whitesilence] That silence was cold, and the frost is still on the walls.
[notice:whitesilence,named] {GOD} came close, and none of us could speak.
[notice:whitesilence,scoffer] A cold quiet spell, people get like that in winter.
[notice:dark] That corner stays dark, whatever we light there.
[notice:dark] The lamps aren't reaching as far as they should.
[notice:dark] The dark's thicker tonight, I don't like it.
[notice:dark,scoffer] Bad lamps and a long night, nothing more to it.
[whisper] Someone's talking to me in the dark, so sweet and so reasonable.
[whisper] I keep hearing a kind voice saying it can make everything better.
[whisper] It knows what I want, it said so, and it sounded kind.
[notice:longnoon] The sun hasn't moved in hours, look at the shadows.
[notice:longnoon] It's too bright and too hot, and it should be later than this.
[notice:longnoon] The panels are giving more than they ever have.
[notice:longnoon,named] {GOD} is staring down, and he won't look away.
[notice:longnoon,scoffer] A long hot day, the kind we get in summer.
[notice:moonsleep] The moon's so close you could read by it.
[notice:moonsleep] It's as light as dusk out here, at this hour.
[notice:moonsleep] Everyone's sleeping so deeply tonight, under that moon.
[notice:moonsleep,named] {GOD} is watching tonight, sleep well under her.
[notice:moonsleep,scoffer] A big moon, a bright night, sleep while you can.
[notice:rain] Something's croaking down in the well, and rain's coming.
[notice:rain] There are frogs everywhere on the wet ground all of a sudden.
[notice:rain] Water's standing by the well, and the air smells of rain.
[notice:rain,named] {GOD} is singing, the rain won't be long.
[notice:rain,scoffer] Frogs and rain, that's spring for you.
[croak] Did you feel that croak, deep in your chest?
[croak] Something old croaked down in the water just now.
[croak,named] That's {GOD} again, down in the wells.
[notice:glint] There's a glint in the stores every time I look away.
[notice:glint] A few coins have wandered off toward the edge of the land.
[notice:glint] A gold beetle just crossed the table and vanished.
[notice:glint,named] {GOD} is going by, so trade while it lasts.
[notice:glint,scoffer] Someone dropped some coins, there's nothing more to it.
[notice:watch] Every cat on the place is sitting with the graves.
[notice:watch] The rats are gone, all of them, overnight.
[notice:watch] The graves smell of warm stone and resin.
[notice:watch,named] {GOD} keeps the watch, so the dead are safe.
[notice:watch,scoffer] Cats like graves, they're warm and quiet.
[notice:revelry] There's a sweet smoke about the place, and nobody's smoking.
[notice:revelry] Somebody laughed in the empty room just now.
[notice:revelry] Everything tastes better today, I don't know why.
[notice:revelry,wrath] Nothing tastes right today, not even the good stuff.
[notice:revelry,named] {GOD} is at the table, so somebody pour him a cup.
[notice:revelry,scoffer] Someone left a pipe burning somewhere, that's the smell.
[notice:growth] The dryads have stopped what they were doing, look at them standing there.
[notice:growth] Seeds keep drifting past me toward that one tree.
[notice:growth] The crops are coming on fast today, you can almost watch them.
[notice:growth,named] {GOD} is listening through the roots today, so go easy with the axe.
[notice:warmstone] The rooms under the rock are warm enough to sleep without a blanket.
[notice:warmstone] There's ore showing in the rock face that I never noticed before.
[notice:warmstone] My boots are warm from standing on the stone.
[notice:warmstone,named] {GOD} is stirring in his sleep, so mind what you dig today.
[notice:grazing] The wild things are grazing side by side as if nobody ever hunted anything.
[notice:grazing] There's been less arguing today than I can remember.
[notice:grazing] The big white beast just keeps grazing, as if it has all the time in the world.
[notice:grazing,named] {GOD} is grazing on our land, so keep the hunters home today.
[notice:rot,night|evening] The spores are glowing in the dark, faint and pale.
[notice:rot] Get the meat into the cold, it'll turn by evening out here.
[notice:rot] The sick ones seem to be getting over it faster today.
[notice:rot,named] {GOD} is near, so bury the dead quickly and keep the food cold.
[notice:warmth] The fire's barely been fed and it's still roaring.
[notice:warmth] Everyone's being so polite to each other this evening.
[notice:warmth] Our guest looks glad just to be sitting by the fire.
[notice:warmth,named] {GOD} is here with us tonight, so nobody leave the fire early.
[notice:hum] The workbench is running smoother than it has in weeks.
[notice:hum] The machines are all humming the same note.
[notice:hum] It feels like the machines are pleased about something today.
[notice:hum,named] {GOD} is awake in the machines today, so say thank you to the bench.
[notice:highsky] The weather hasn't changed one bit all day.
[notice:highsky] I keep looking up, and I keep feeling looked at.
[notice:highsky] There isn't a single bird left in the trees.
[notice:highsky,named] {GOD} is looking down on us, so stand up straight.
[notice:whitesilence] Nothing left outside is going off in this cold.
[notice:whitesilence] Keep the little ones and the old ones by the fire, this cold goes right through them.
[notice:whitesilence] There's frost all along the walls, inside and out.
[notice:whitesilence,named] {GOD} is near, so keep the fires high and the doors shut.
[notice:dark] I lit another lamp and the corner's still dark.
[notice:dark] The light just stops short of the wall, as if it's hitting something.
[notice:dark] My head feels open tonight, like anything could get in.
[notice:dark] Stay where the light is, all of you.
[notice:longnoon] My shadow hasn't moved since I started this row.
[notice:longnoon] The crops are drinking up this sun, look at them.
[notice:longnoon] Nobody who works nights is getting any sleep in this light.
[notice:longnoon,named] {GOD} is standing still over us, so get the planting done.
[notice:moonsleep] The ones who slept under that moon look well rested.
[notice:moonsleep] I can see all the way to the edge of the land by moonlight.
[notice:moonsleep] The moon's hanging so low it looks close enough to touch.
[notice:moonsleep,named,night|evening] {GOD} is close tonight, so sleep and let her mend you.
[notice:watch] Not one rat anywhere today.
[notice:watch] The cats are all sitting facing the graves again.
[notice:watch] That big cat walks among the graves like she owns them.
[notice:watch,named] {GOD} is keeping watch over our dead, so leave the graves be.
[notice:rain] I can feel that croak in my ribs.
[notice:rain] The plants by the water are coming on faster than the rest.
[notice:rain] The air's gone heavy, rain's not far off.
[notice:rain,named] {GOD} is singing down there, so leave the wells alone today.
[notice:glint] The coins in the stores keep catching the light.
[notice:glint] If anyone comes to trade today, we'll get a good price, I can feel it.
[notice:glint] Count the silver, I'm sure it's moved since this morning.
[notice:glint,named] {GOD} is passing through, so spend a coin and keep it moving.
[notice:revelry] It doesn't take much to make anyone laugh today.
[notice:revelry] The air smells sweet, like a party's just ended.
[notice:revelry] I'd take a day like this every week.
[notice:revelry,named] {GOD} is about the place, so pour him his share before supper.
[warmvoice] I dreamed a warm voice under the rock, very patient, asking what I'd give.
[warmvoice] Something deep in the mountain talked to me all night, warm as a hearth.
[warmvoice] I dreamed of gold in the dark and a voice that knew my name.
[true:raid] I dreamed of blades at the walls, so we'd best be ready.
[true:raid] I saw strangers with weapons coming to the gate in my dream.
[true:visitors] I dreamed a stranger came up the road with a full pack.
[true:visitors] Someone's coming to visit, I saw them on the road in my sleep.
[true:predator] I dreamed of a {BEAST} in the long grass {SITE}, watching us.
[true:predator] There's teeth out {SITE}, I saw them in my dream.
[true:rot] I dreamed the stores were going soft, someone check the food.
[true:rot] In my dream the food was rotting where it sat.
[true:sad] I dreamed {OTHER} was crying where nobody could see.
[true:sad] Someone should sit with {OTHER}, I dreamed of them all night.
[true:moon] I dreamed the moon came down and sat with me a while.
[true:moon] I dreamed of silver water, and nothing bad at all.
[warmvoice] Someone under the floor asked me very politely what I wanted most.
[warmvoice] I dreamed of a warm dark place full of silver, and a voice that wanted to bargain.
[true:raid] I dreamed of smoke on the road and people with weapons coming this way.
[true:raid] In my dream the dogs barked at the gate all night, so be ready.
[true:visitors] I dreamed of travellers stopping at our gate to ask for water.
[true:visitors] Someone's on the road to us, I saw their pack in my dream.
[true:predator] I dreamed something with teeth was lying in wait {SITE}.
[true:predator] I dreamed of a {BEAST} {SITE}, so nobody walk out there alone.
[true:rot] I dreamed the bread was green and the meat was crawling, so check the stores.
[true:rot] I dreamed of flies over the food, someone look at it today.
[true:sad] I dreamed {OTHER} was sitting alone in the dark, so someone go and see them.
[true:sad] In my dream {OTHER} wouldn't stop crying, and nobody noticed.
[true:moon] I dreamed I was floating on a lake of moonlight, and I woke up rested.
[true:moon] I dreamed the moon told me a story, and it was a kind one.
[way:sapling,!scoffer] A young tree where the gift was, {GOD} took it into the ground.
[way:sapling,!scoffer] It's gone, and look, a sapling in its place.
[way:sapling,scoffer] A seed in the dirt and some rain, that's your sapling.
[way:crack,!scoffer] It's gone down the crack, and the floor's still warm.
[way:crack,!scoffer] Feel the stone, {GOD} took it down into the deep.
[way:crack,scoffer] It rolled down a crack, and the rock's warm from the sun.
[way:grazed,!scoffer] Grazed clean, and that hoofprint is bigger than my hand.
[way:grazed,!scoffer] Something huge was here in the night and ate it gently.
[way:grazed,scoffer] A deer had it, and stood in the mud doing it.
[way:rot,!scoffer] It's gone back to the earth, {GOD} took it as she takes everything.
[way:rot,!scoffer] Black soil and a mushroom, where the gift was yesterday.
[way:rot,scoffer] It rotted, that's what food does if you leave it out.
[way:guest,!scoffer] Footprints in, and none out, so someone came for it.
[way:guest,!scoffer] A guest took it in the night, and walked nowhere after.
[way:guest,scoffer] Someone walked in and took it, and walked out on the path.
[way:mended,!scoffer] The part's gone, and the broken one's running again.
[way:mended,!scoffer] {GOD} took the part and fixed the machine with it.
[way:mended,scoffer] Someone fixed that machine in the night and won't own up.
[way:takenup,!scoffer] It went up in the night, I saw the light go.
[way:takenup,!scoffer] Taken up into the sky, the place is empty under the stars.
[way:takenup,scoffer] A shooting star and a thief, both on the same night.
[way:frost,!scoffer] Frost all over the place where it was, and the gift gone.
[way:frost,!scoffer] {GOD} frosted it over and took it at dawn.
[way:frost,scoffer] A hard frost and a hungry fox, that's all.
[way:hunger,!scoffer] It's gone, and something else of ours is gone with it.
[way:hunger,!scoffer] It always takes more than it's given, I said it would.
[way:hunger,scoffer] We've got a thief, and they're not even careful.
[way:moon,!scoffer] It went under the moon, the place still has a silver look.
[way:moon,!scoffer] {GOD} showed her face and took the silver.
[way:moon,scoffer] A moonlit thief, very poetic, and our silver's gone.
[way:well,!scoffer] It went down into the water, I heard the croak.
[way:well,!scoffer] {GOD} took it down into the well, and sang after.
[way:well,scoffer] Someone threw it in the well, and a frog complained.
[way:cat,!scoffer] A cat had it at dawn, that's how she takes it.
[way:cat,!scoffer] Paw prints all around it, {GOD} sent her cats.
[way:cat,scoffer] The cats ate it, cats eat everything.
[way:cup,!scoffer] It's gone, and the ground smells of drink where it stood.
[way:cup,!scoffer] Somebody drank it in the night, and spilled the last of it.
[way:cup,scoffer] Someone had a drink on the quiet and spilled the rest.
[way:given,visitor] This is for me, truly, from your shrine?
[way:given,visitor] I'll carry it on, as you say, and pass it to someone else.
[way:given,visitor] Gold given to a stranger, your people are odd and kind.
[way:sapling,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} took it into the ground and gave us a tree for it.
[way:sapling,theirs,!scoffer] A sapling where the gift was, and they say that's how {GOD} takes it.
[way:sapling,!scoffer] I'd swear that little tree wasn't there yesterday.
[way:sapling,scoffer] Somebody planted a sapling and walked off with the gift, that's all.
[way:crack,mine,!scoffer] Down into the rock with it, {GOD} keeps what he's given.
[way:crack,theirs,!scoffer] It's gone down the crack, and the ones who pray there say it went to {GOD}.
[way:crack,!scoffer] Put your hand on the floor there, it's still warm.
[way:crack,scoffer] Leave anything by a crack long enough and it rolls down it.
[way:grazed,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} came by in the night and ate it, and left his print to show it.
[way:grazed,theirs,!scoffer] It's been grazed, and they'll say {GOD} was here by the size of that print.
[way:grazed,!scoffer] Look at the size of that hoofprint next to it.
[way:grazed,scoffer] A big animal had it, and big animals leave big prints.
[way:rot,mine,!scoffer] It's soil now, and {GOD} has had her share.
[way:rot,theirs,!scoffer] Black earth and a mushroom, and they say that's {GOD}'s way of taking it.
[way:rot,!scoffer] It went soft and black overnight, and there's a mushroom where it lay.
[way:rot,scoffer] It went off in the damp, and that's the weather, not a goddess.
[way:guest,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} came as a guest in the night and took it, look at the footprints.
[way:guest,theirs,!scoffer] Footprints going in and none coming back, and they'll say {GOD} made them.
[way:guest,!scoffer] Someone walked up to it in the night and never walked away again.
[way:guest,scoffer] There'll be prints going out too, if you look hard enough.
[way:mended,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} had the part, and it'll be in one of our machines by now.
[way:mended,theirs,!scoffer] The part's gone, and {GOD}'s faithful say it went where it was needed.
[way:mended,!scoffer] The part we left is gone, and I didn't see anyone take it.
[way:mended,scoffer] Someone borrowed that part for a repair and forgot to say.
[way:takenup,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} took it up in the night, straight up into the sky.
[way:takenup,theirs,!scoffer] It's gone from under the open sky, and they say {GOD} took it up.
[way:takenup,!scoffer] There was a streak of light over the place last night, and now it's gone.
[way:takenup,scoffer] A bird took it, and a bright night made a story of it.
[way:frost,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} came close in the night and took it, frost and all.
[way:frost,theirs,!scoffer] Frozen in the night and gone at first light, and they'll say that's {GOD}.
[way:frost,!scoffer] There's still frost on the ground where it was lying.
[way:frost,scoffer] Things freeze at night and animals eat them in the morning.
[way:hunger,mine,!scoffer] It took the gift and something besides, as {GOD} always does.
[way:hunger,theirs,!scoffer] The gift's gone and so is something else, and nobody wants to say what took it.
[way:hunger,!scoffer] Check the stores, the gift isn't the only thing missing.
[way:hunger,scoffer] Two things gone in one night means a thief, not a god.
[way:moon,mine,!scoffer] It went last night under the moon, as {GOD}'s gifts do.
[way:moon,theirs,!scoffer] It was there until the moon came up, and they say {GOD} took it then.
[way:moon,!scoffer] It's gone, and the moon was out over it all night.
[way:moon,scoffer] Clear night, bright moon, easy work for a thief.
[way:well,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} took it down into the water, and I heard the croak after.
[way:well,theirs,!scoffer] It's gone into the wet ground, and they say {GOD} pulled it under.
[way:well,!scoffer] There was a croak from down below last night, and now the gift's gone.
[way:well,scoffer] It sank in the mud, and the frogs made the noise they always make.
[way:cat,mine,!scoffer] One of {GOD}'s cats had it at dawn, which is how she takes a gift.
[way:cat,theirs,!scoffer] A cat had it, and the ones who keep {GOD} say that's how she takes it.
[way:cat,!scoffer] It was gone by dawn, and I'd bet a cat had it.
[way:cat,scoffer] Leave food out and the cats will have it, every time.
[way:cup,mine,!scoffer] {GOD} drank it off in the night, and left the ground wet for us to see.
[way:cup,theirs,!scoffer] It's been drunk where it stood, and they say that's {GOD}'s share taken.
[way:cup,!scoffer] The ground's still wet there, and it smells like the inside of a barrel.
[way:cup,scoffer] Whoever has a sore head this morning drank it, not a god.
[way:given,visitor] Your shrine gave me this, so I'll pass it on to the next one who needs it.
[way:given,visitor] I didn't expect a gift from strangers, thank you.
[way:given,visitor] Gold from a shrine for a passing traveller, I'll tell them about this on the road.
